name: The Patient Garden
summary: A night garden too dense to see, lit only by the small lamp you carry. Seven buds open only if you stand still beside them and pay attention; fireflies drift toward the ones still closed. When all have bloomed and the garden has had its time, a door of light grows at its centre.

idea.name: Lushness answers to stillness
idea.premise: Abundance is not taken by moving through it but by staying: the overgrown dark garden opens only to those who stop. Attention is the only fertiliser, and the way onward is a thing that grows from having waited.
